description: Original illustrated cover with a brass magnifying glass over a clue notebook; library garden castle museum and observatory props; text drawn as vector type
style line ref: STYLE_FORMULA: Soft hand-painted gouache on lightly textured warm paper, with rounded object shapes and fine ink outlines that feel like clues in an explorer’s notebook. Locations sit in pine green, dusty indigo, and muted plum, while clue objects and discovery marks pop in coral and antique brass. Warm lamplight makes the mystery cozy and playful. Keep shapes simple, text areas quiet and high-contrast, and every scene composed in a clear flat frontal perspective.
